page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, totaling 8 vCPUs. It is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average capabilities for single-core processing, memory read bandwidth, and basic text and image processing. Specifically, the instance achieves average scores in Geekbench single-core tests, software compilation, and Redis SET operations, alongside a static web serving throughput of 7.11 GB/sec. However, multi-core performance, memory write bandwidth, and database operations fall into the lower 25% tier. Large-model LLM inference is highly constrained, with the medium 7B model processing prompts at 11.01 tokens per second and generating text at 5.29 tokens per second.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.cm4.2xlarge offers a stable hardware profile for workloads that do not require local storage or high-performance multi-threaded compute. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, basic web serving, Redis caching, and lightweight single-threaded processing. Users requiring high-speed database transactions or intensive multi-core parallel processing may face performance bottlenecks due to the weaker multi-core and write bandwidth characteristics.
